description: This PHP source file defines the FactorAuthEmailCode class implementing email-based two-factor authentication for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for displaying the token input form, sending the authentication code via email, and validating email template configurations.

classes.name: FactorAuthEmailCode
classes.description: Implements email-based two-factor authentication, including displaying a token input form, sending email tokens, and validating email templates.

methods.name: showTokenInput
methods.description: Displays an HTML form for user to input the authentication token, using Smarty templates and current theme assets.

methods.name: sendToken
methods.description: Sends an email containing the authentication code to the user using configured email templates and SugarPHPMailer. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: validateTokenMessage
methods.description: Checks if the email template for two-factor authentication is properly configured, including the presence of a $code placeholder.
